steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each project is placed by its value, its risk and its cost.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 cut is proposed without a reason

findings.title: Cut proposed with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason for the cut

findings.title: Rank does not follow from the criteria

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] proj-3.md:12  Cut proposed with no reason.
       Fix: Give the reason for the cut.
[medium] proj-2.md:19  Project with no value score.
       Fix: Score the project's value.
[low] proj-6.md:26  Rank does not follow from the criteria.
       Fix: Re-rank from the stated criteria.
Not checked: Strategic value beyond the criteria.
pros: Checks a project with no value score, a rank that does not follow from the stated criteria, and a cut proposed with no reason.
cons: Not checked: Strategic value beyond the criteria.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-portfolio-prioritisation skill on the records for this review.
